title: Aureline M5 historical snapshot descriptor
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a retirement / last-supported snapshot or a captured support / export evidence bundle held as non-live historical reference. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the captured-evidence / archived-snapshot label, the capture time, the provenance / capture context, the mutation-blocked posture, and the retention / expiry / removal state so the object can be inspected without ever reading as a current, editable live object. Downstream shell, help / docs, support, and companion / export surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's snapshot descriptor by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
